section_summary: This section comprises U.S. State Department despatches and enclosed General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (GHQ SCAP) records from March 1948 relating to the Japanese Diet and legislative affairs. It is dominated by the comprehensive February 1948 report of the United States Library Mission to Japan, headed by Verner W. Clapp, detailing the organization, functions, administration, collections, and building requirements for the newly created National Diet Library, along with the full texts of the National Diet Library Law and Building Commission Law. Additionally, the section includes SCAP Government Section regulations adopted by the Diet in July 1947 that govern joint operations, joint examination meetings, and the Legislative Committee of the Houses.

subfiles.about: Comprehensive advisory report outlining objectives, organizational structure, administration, collections, building plans, and legislation for establishing the National Diet Library of Japan.
subfiles.from: United States Library Mission to Japan (Verner W. Clapp, Chairman; Charles H. Brown)
subfiles.summary: This report by the United States Library Mission outlines recommendations for establishing the National Diet Library as a democratic national library serving the Diet, executive and judicial agencies, and the Japanese public. It details the library's objectives, administrative hierarchy, departmental functions, professional personnel standards, and collection development policies, including legal deposit and branch library integration. Additionally, the report outlines architectural principles and space requirements for a new building, budgetary priorities, education for librarianship, and the texts of the National Diet Library Law and Building Commission Law enacted on February 4, 1948.
